0R.d: decent, but too cornered. Demos also like to blind fire over the rockface if they know something is back there.
best overall, promotes team coverage of cliff
Demos like to blind fire over the rockface if they know something is back there.

watches slope and cart but more vulnerable to long range spam

better to use this spot once the cart has exited the tunnel

best overall

watches slope while protected from long range spam
decent. The hitbox is slightly hidden when viewing from slope, it watches the cart and most of rearward cliff. downside is it's very vulnerable to spies

1R.d: decent but easy to spot from backyard

best overall

important to get set up as BLU is on their final stretch to capping A. Enemies are quick to make their way upstairs after that.

2R.d:
very aggressive 

great coverage, but slightly vulnerable to a part of boiler room that is out of range
has long range sightline vulnerabilities and relies on team to cover those sightlines. Wrangler and rescue ranger advised.

forward hold

vulnerable to boiler room sightlines
less exposed to boiler room, slightly worse coverage
this spot is better if your team is covering the cart as this will keep it out of sight from tires

3R.d: this spot is better if your team is covering the cart as this will keep it out of sight from tires

decent, open to fire from map room

better to switch between the two cubbies at random

decent, open to fire from balcony/tires

better to switch between the two cubbies at random

final stand for D

be sure to place it at a height where it's hitbox is slightly hidden but it's gun clears

not much use for active teleporters at this stage

use your exit as an alarm for enemies coming down staircase, they can't resist shooting it.

3B.d:
best overall

puts your team out of sniper sightlines

0B.d: right font spawn is the most covered
use wrangler to assist with a slope push

1B.d: filters team behind enemy if a ground push isn't working
only if you're filtering your team through with the backyard tele

2B.d: furthest back an exit should be
if your team is holding boiler room you should have your sentry covering shack
